recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for the current core branch. If OccupationalData is ever resurrected or republished in an active FHIR or external ODH specification, re-review the full OccupationalData model rather than making only a stale-source combatZonePeriod edit.
issue_request: FHIR-14741 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core OccupationalData PHER request to rename combatZoneWork to combatZonePeriod because the element represents a period of combat-zone work, not a flag-like work concept.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the request was applied as svn 13307. Git commit 1834d69412f3ba4890c5930897e1a58b6c98aad0 is that svn revision and explicitly references FHIR-14741/#192 while changing both the XML example and spreadsheet row from combatZoneWork to combatZonePeriod.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has only a commented OccupationalDataforHealth entry marked Dropped, so OccupationalData is outside the current core build. The inactive source/occupationaldata files still use combatZonePeriod, the FHIR Extension Pack checkout has no OccupationalData definition, PHWG minutes corroborate the persuasive Comment 192 decision, and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence Jira-reference evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Editing the inactive OccupationalData files would not affect the current built specification, and the remaining inactive source already reflects the requested rename.
